notes: InstallMethod::SkillsSh, project scope. academy-guide is installed, then its SKILL.md is corrupted by this script (not the CLI) so update has a real, deterministic content change to refetch and restore - verified by before/after sha256, not stdout wording (skills update always prints Updated regardless of whether content changed).
